title: Underlying resolution section homology equivalences
statement: For a scheme morphism g, an abelian étale sheaf G, injective resolutions I and J, and an augmentation-preserving cochain map α, there exist degreewise additive equivalences from the global and every open resolution-section homology complex to the corresponding sheaf cohomology groups. The statement records no compatibility identities beyond the four equivalence families.

proof.text: For an object A representing evaluation at W through a natural additive Hom equivalence, construct an isomorphism from the Hom complex out of A[0] to the universe-lifted section complex of the integer extension of the prescribed resolution. Naturality in the resolution differential gives the chain-map identity. Apply InjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass, HomComplex.leftHomologyData, and the homology-preserving ulift functor. The mapExtendIso and extendHomologyIso comparisons return to natural-number-indexed homology. This is a direct Lean construction, adapting the already proved resolution_section_cohomology argument to larger coefficients.

At the terminal identity etale object, take A to be the constant integer sheaf. The constantSheafAdj homAddEquiv followed by uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv represents sections, naturally in the coefficient sheaf. The preceding construction therefore identifies global section homology with Sheaf.H in every degree.

At the open object W, take A to be the sheafification of the free abelian presheaf on uliftYoneda(W). Use EtaleOpenComparison.sectionsEquiv and its naturality for the preceding construction. Compose with etaleCohomologyOverOpenEquiv, then with the Ext functor applied to the inverse of upperStarIsoOpenImmersionRestriction at the coefficient sheaf. This gives the open section homology comparison, including the empty open and degree zero.

Apply the global and open constructions independently to I and to J. Classical choice of witnesses of the proved Nonempty comparisons assembles the four equivalence families; the final True is immediate. No data is defined from an unproved existence result, and the map alpha and its augmentation identity are unnecessary for this existence-only conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_resolutionSection_homology_data
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution G)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G))
    (α : I.cocomplex ⟶
      ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (hα : I.ι.f 0 ≫ α.f 0 =
      (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).unit.app G ≫
        (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).map (J.ι.f 0)) :
    ∃ eX : ∀ q : ℕ,
      (((etaleSectionFunctor (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
        I.cocomplex).homology q ≃+ Sheaf.H G q,
    ∃ eOX : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (q : ℕ),
      (((etaleSectionFunctor (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
        I.cocomplex).homology q ≃+
          Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} W.ι).obj G) q,
    ∃ eY : ∀ q : ℕ,
      (((etaleSectionFunctor (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
        J.cocomplex).homology q ≃+
          Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G) q,
    ∃ eOY : ∀ (W : Y.Opens) (q : ℕ),
      (((etaleSectionFunctor (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
        J.cocomplex).homology q ≃+
          Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} W.ι).obj
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G)) q, True
